subject: CAIQ priority ledger + extraction runbook — EquinoxHealth scope
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@equinoxhealth.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ request: evidence for high-priority controls

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this on. We're running a scoped CAIQ review for a deadline of next Wednesday and need a prioritized set of artifacts focused on the top 12 controls that our security team flags as in-scope. The list below is what they asked for (short names / CCM ids):

- Identity lifecycle (ID-01, ID-02)
- Data in transit encryption (DT-04)
- Key management / HSM (KM-03)
- Logging & retention (LG-02)
- Runtime segregation (RS-01)
- Change control / deployment approvals (CC-05)
- Incident response / detection (IR-02)
- Backup & recovery (BR-01)
- Privileged access reviews (PA-03)
- Vendor third-party controls (TP-01)
- Data classification (DC-01)
- Network boundary / diagrams (NB-02)

Can you provide a mapping workbook that clearly ties each CAIQ question to the artifact we will hand over, plus an extraction runbook and sample log bundle (redacted if needed)? They asked for evidence and owner at the control/subcontrol level, and a sample extraction window of 7 days.

Please let me know if you need a narrower scope. Target delivery: Friday EOB (11/06) would be ideal so we can review ahead of the Wed review.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Security Lead, EquinoxHealth

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: evidence for high-priority controls

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We've sketched a lightweight plan and will provide: a CAIQ mapping workbook (one row per question with control id + artifact pointer), a prioritized ledger indicating owner and delivery ETA, an extraction runbook (how we pulled logs + redaction notes), and a 7-day sample log bundle.

Quick plan (attachments listed below):
- Deliverable 1: caiq_priority_ledger.xlsx — mapping + assigned owners + priority tag
- Deliverable 2: extraction_runbook.md — CLI steps, queries, redaction guidance
- Deliverable 3: runtime-logs-20261101-20261107.tar.gz — sanitized log set (if you confirm PII redaction scope)
- Deliverable 4: network-diagram.pdf — high-level boundary for NB-02

Proposed internal owners: Kimberly (access & identity artifacts / ID-*), Marcus (runtime logs, LG-02, RS-01), Priyom (KMS/HSM, backups, TP-01).

Ask for you: confirm whether the 7-day window 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-07 is acceptable and whether we should redact IP addresses only or also token identifiers. If you want full redaction we will provide an attestation note and sampling hashes.

I'll push the initial ledger and runbook to the Drive link and circulate the sanitized archive once Marcus confirms extraction.

Next steps:
1) Samir confirm redaction scope and 7-day window
2) Marcus produce logs
3) We upload artifacts to shared folder and let you know where to review

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: CAIQ extract owners + tasks (EquinoxHealth)

Kimberly / Marcus / Priyom — looping you in to confirm owners and blockers.

Assigned tasks (short):
- Kimberly: Pull IAM proofpoints (SAML assertions, IdP config snapshots, periodic access review exports). Attach sample snapshots and an owner attestation.
- Marcus: Export runtime logs (token lifecycle events, kv-cache evictions, request traces) for 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-07. Please follow the extraction_runbook.md redaction flags (PII: redact, tokens: hash).
- Priyom: Provide KMS usage report, key rotation policy, and backup snapshots for BR-01.

Timeline: need initial artifacts to Chloe by EOD 11/06 so we can stage for Equinox review on 11/07. If any item will slip, flag here immediately.

Marcus — can you confirm storage location and expected artifact size?

Thanks — C

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 13:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: CAIQ extract owners + tasks (EquinoxHealth)

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 11:02 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus: Export runtime logs (token lifecycle events, kv-cache evictions, request traces) for 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-07.

Got it. I'll generate the archive and apply the hash-only redaction for tokens (we'll keep IP ranges truncated). Expecting a ~120MB tar.gz (logs compressed). Will drop at gs://redwood-shared/equinox/caiq/runtime-logs-20261101-20261107.tar.gz and notify when ready.

—Marcus

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@equinoxhealth.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: evidence for high-priority controls

Chloe — thanks for the quick turnaround. 7-day window is fine. Please redact token IDs and user email addresses; internal IP truncation is acceptable. We also need a short attestation (one paragraph) that the samples are representative and that any redaction is deterministic (you can include hash salt if helpful).

One more: can you include a short mapping so our reviewer can see the precise CAIQ question id -> artifact filename? That will speed review.

Appreciate it,
Samir

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivered: CAIQ priority ledger + evidence bundle (EquinoxHealth)

Samir — attached are the artifacts for your review and the requested mapping:

Attachments delivered:
- caiq_priority_ledger.xlsx (sheet 1 = question -> artifact map; sheet 2 = owner + ETA)
- extraction_runbook.md (CLI commands, redaction checklist, deterministic salting approach)
- runtime-logs-20261101-20261107.tar.gz (tokens hashed with salt "equinox-s1", IPs truncated to /24)
- network-diagram.pdf (illustrates NB-02 boundary)

Short attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms that the attached log samples were produced from production runtime telemetry for 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-07. All PII was redacted using a deterministic one-way HMAC with salt 'equinox-s1'; IP addresses were truncated to /24. The samples are representative of normal traffic and were selected to include peak and off-peak windows."

Link to review folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-example-equnix-caiq
HubSpot (deal): https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-4721

If your reviewer wants an additional artifact (e.g., a longer log window or raw IdP metadata), let us know and we'll scope it. Otherwise we can close this sprint after your team reviews the ledger.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
